sayLines: A person, maybe 30s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A person, maybe 20s sets out to find A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin. "Won't be long."
A woman, maybe 40s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A man, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 50s, with weathered hands heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A man, maybe 40s sets out to find A man, maybe 60s. "Won't be long."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
💬 A woman, maybe 30s has A person, maybe 60s, with a limp's ear — quiet talk, the kind that doesn't need an audience.
A man, maybe 50s, with calloused knuckles is stirring the pot slow, fishing out a bone to check the meat.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Molt**. It resonates with: something unnamed.
